summary: Oriental Culture Holding LTD filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited first-half 2026 results (period ended June 30, 2026): revenue roughly $1.0 million versus $0.1 million, gross margin 99.3%, operating income $9,433, net income about $0.9 million versus a prior-year net loss. The filing also recounts a January 2026 1-for-220 share consolidation, a March authorized-share increase to 100 million ordinary shares, an April $10 million Jade Cove subscription for a 66.67% limited-partner interest, and a May $260 million Form F-3 shelf. No special-situations event is present; routine results disclosure only.
